name: How long does it take to clean up fire extinguisher powder?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to clean up fire extinguisher powder?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of fire extinguisher powder cleanup varies significantly based on the scale of the discharge and the complexity of the affected environment. A small, contained area might take a few hours, while a larger space with extensive contamination, especially involving intricate systems like HVAC or sensitive electronics, could require several days. After an initial assessment, our team can provide a more precise timeline for your specific situation.
